anchor: TTFT p99 grows $1.24\times$ and the maximum TTFT and inter-token latency roughly double ($1.8\times$ and $1.9\times$)
claim_text: Under calibrated timing, TTFT p99 increases by 1.24 times, maximum TTFT increases by 1.8 times, and inter-token latency increases by 1.9 times compared to the polynomial timing model.

adjudication.observed: TTFT p99 ratio = 1.24x (307.36ms vs 248.46ms), TTFT max ratio = 1.78x (4517.57ms vs 2539.91ms), ITL max ratio = 1.92x (347.73ms vs 180.70ms)
adjudication.evidence: The claim is fully supported by comparing calibrated timing (aic) and polynomial timing (poly) in llm_run_summary. Metrics align exactly: TTFT p99 grows 1.24x (307.36/248.46 = 1.237), TTFT max grows 1.78x ≈ 1.8x (4517.57/2539.91 = 1.779), and max ITL grows 1.92x ≈ 1.9x (347.73/180.70 = 1.924). Prior verifiers mistakenly evaluated mean_itl (1.13x) or p99_itl (0.76x) instead of max_itl (ITL max).
adjudication.query: WITH poly AS (SELECT p99_ttft_ms, max_ttft_ms, (metrics->>'max_itl_ms')::double precision AS max_itl_ms FROM provenance.llm_run_summary WHERE run_id = 'srcbuild:llm_head2k_poly_src'), aic AS (SELECT p99_ttft_ms, max_ttft_ms, (metrics->>'max_itl_ms')::double precision AS max_itl_ms FROM provenance.llm_run_summary WHERE run_id = 'srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src') SELECT (aic.p99_ttft_ms / poly.p99_ttft_ms) AS ttft_p99_ratio, (aic.max_ttft_ms / poly.max_ttft_ms) AS ttft_max_ratio, (aic.max_itl_ms / poly.max_itl_ms) AS itl_max_ratio FROM poly, aic;

adjudication.observed: For 2000 requests per timing model, effective AIC/poly ratios are TTFT p99 1.237055746033318, maximum TTFT 1.7786306504261427, and mean ITL 1.1305977871112747; p99 ITL is 0.7622592554198656.
adjudication.evidence: The effective current, unsuperseded srcbuild rows support the TTFT multipliers but not 1.9x ITL: mean ITL is 7.671204805927105/6.785087405422364 = 1.1305977871112747, while p99 ITL is 22.635453999973834/29.695217000029515 = 0.7622592554198656.
adjudication.fix: Replace the ITL multiplier with 1.13x and avoid saying both metrics roughly double: “TTFT p99 grows 1.24x, maximum TTFT grows 1.8x, and mean inter-token latency grows 1.13x.”
adjudication.query:
WITH dim AS (
  SELECT run_id, window_name, is_current, superseded_by
  FROM provenance.v_dim
  WHERE is_current = TRUE
    AND run_id ~ '^(srcbuild:llm_head2k_(aic|poly)_src|sweeps:llm_head2k_(aic|poly)_s[0-9]+)$'
), effective AS (
  SELECT e.*
  FROM dim d
  JOIN provenance.llm_head2k_poly_aic_effective e
    ON e.srcbuild_run_id = d.run_id
  WHERE d.superseded_by IS NULL
), latency AS (
  SELECT d.run_id, d.window_name, d.is_current, d.superseded_by,
         p.sla_metric, p.p99_ms, p.max_ms, p.n_requests
  FROM dim d
  JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p USING (run_id)
  WHERE d.superseded_by IS NULL
), overall AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.timing = 'aic' THEN e.srcbuild_run_id END) AS aic_run_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.timing = 'poly' THEN e.srcbuild_run_id END) AS poly_run_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.timing = 'aic' THEN e.effective_build END) AS aic_effective_build,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.timing = 'poly' THEN e.effective_build END) AS poly_effective_build,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.timing = 'aic' THEN e.effective_p99_ttft_ms END) AS aic_p99_ttft_ms,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.timing = 'poly' THEN e.effective_p99_ttft_ms END) AS poly_p99_ttft_ms,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.timing = 'aic' THEN e.effective_max_ttft_ms END) AS aic_max_ttft_ms,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.timing = 'poly' THEN e.effective_max_ttft_ms END) AS poly_max_ttft_ms,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.timing = 'aic' THEN e.srcbuild_mean_itl_ms END) AS aic_mean_itl_ms,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.timing = 'poly' THEN e.srcbuild_mean_itl_ms END) AS poly_mean_itl_ms
  FROM effective e
), pool_overall AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN run_id = 'srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src' AND sla_metric = 'ttft' THEN n_requests END) AS aic_n_requests,
    MAX(CASE WHEN run_id = 'srcbuild:llm_head2k_poly_src' AND sla_metric = 'ttft' THEN n_requests END) AS poly_n_requests,
    MAX(CASE WHEN run_id = 'srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src' AND sla_metric = 'itl' THEN p99_ms END) AS aic_p99_itl_ms,
    MAX(CASE WHEN run_id = 'srcbuild:llm_head2k_poly_src' AND sla_metric = 'itl' THEN p99_ms END) AS poly_p99_itl_ms
  FROM latency
), sweep_breakdown AS (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(
           jsonb_build_object(
             'run_id', run_id,
             'window_name', window_name,
             'is_current', is_current,
             'superseded_by', superseded_by,
             'sla_metric', sla_metric,
             'p99_ms', p99_ms,
             'max_ms', max_ms,
             'n_requests', n_requests
           ) ORDER BY run_id, sla_metric
         ) AS current_unsuperseded_rows
  FROM latency
  WHERE run_id LIKE 'sweeps:%'
)
SELECT o.*, p.aic_n_requests, p.poly_n_requests,
       o.aic_p99_ttft_ms / o.poly_p99_ttft_ms AS p99_ttft_ratio,
       o.aic_max_ttft_ms / o.poly_max_ttft_ms AS max_ttft_ratio,
       o.aic_mean_itl_ms / o.poly_mean_itl_ms AS mean_itl_ratio,
       p.aic_p99_itl_ms, p.poly_p99_itl_ms,
       p.aic_p99_itl_ms / p.poly_p99_itl_ms AS p99_itl_ratio,
       s.current_unsuperseded_rows AS sweep_breakdown
FROM overall o
CROSS JOIN pool_overall p
CROSS JOIN sweep_breakdown s
